reviews.title: Very Disappointing Customer Service!
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Trendyol’s return service. My return package pickup was scheduled for October 30, 2026, but nobody showed up to collect it.

I contacted customer support several times, but all I received were repeated automated responses. They marked my request as resolved without actually collecting my package or providing a proper solution.

Even after multiple follow-ups, I still have no confirmed pickup date.

This is unacceptable customer service. Customers deserve proper support, clear communication, and real solutions, not repeated automated replies.

I hope Trendyol takes this complaint seriously and improves its return and customer support services.

reviews.title: Randomly freezes accounts with ZERO support
reviews.text: Worst e-commerce platform I have ever used. Trendyol randomly froze my account for vague "security reasons" and completely blocked me from making purchases. When I contacted Live Chat to resolve it or verify my identity, the agents were completely useless. They told me there is "no next step," refused to escalate the issue, and admitted their own customer service department isn't even given the information needed to help customers. Then they had the audacity to paste a generic message saying "I hope I shared all the helpful information with you." Don't waste your time or money on an app that locks out paying customers for no reason and offers zero accountability.

reviews.title: Hidden Price Increases at Checkout – Misleading Pricing
reviews.text:
I’ve encountered this issue with multiple products on Trendyol Saudi Arabia. The price displayed on the product listing page is lower than the price charged when the item is added to the cart.

This is not a VAT issue, but an unexplained price increase that is not clearly disclosed upfront. Such misleading pricing practices undermine customer trust and transparency.

Displaying one price and increasing it at checkout is unacceptable. Trendyol needs to address this issue and ensure that the prices shown to customers are accurate and consistent throughout the shopping process.

reviews.title: Different item delivered
reviews.text: Disappointed by them, they delivered different item, when I asked for exchange they refused. Additionally on delivery note on their billing and everywhere they put original product details while at delivery they delivered different product. I have all the details… I hope they better fix this ….

The app has a lot of products and a great variety, but unfortunately the user experience is one of the worst I’ve had. The search function is very poor, and even the suggestions rarely match what I’m actually looking for. For example, if I search for black heels or apply filters, I still get completely unrelated items like red heels. The filters don’t work properly, which makes shopping frustrating.

The app is also slow, and every time I add an item to my cart, it automatically takes me to the cart instead of letting me continue browsing. It’s a small thing, but it becomes very annoying.

Because of these issues, Trendyol is always my last choice compared to other shopping apps, despite having a wide selection of products. I really hope the app’s search, filters, speed, and overall usability are improved.

reviews.title: Pricing Issues
reviews.text:
My experience with Trendyol has become frustrating due to several issues.

First, the search function is extremely poor. When I search for a specific item, the results often show completely unrelated products or items that are only vaguely similar to what I’m looking for. If the exact item is unavailable, why not simply show that it is out of stock instead of filling the search results with completely different products?

Second, there is a serious issue with product pricing. The item shows one price in the app, a different price in the cart, and then the price increases again when I proceed to place the order. Why does this happen? The price displayed when selecting the item should be the actual price I pay at checkout.

Finally, are customers expected to split their orders or create a new email address and phone number every time just to get a discount? Why should customers have to find ways around the system to get a fair price?

I hope Trendyol addresses these issues, because the current search and pricing system makes the shopping experience frustrating and unreliable.

reviews.title: Wrong Item Delivered, No Return Pickup, No Refund
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Trendyol.

I received the wrong item, and since July 2, I have been requesting an update regarding my return pickup. Instead of helping resolve the issue, the customer service agents repeatedly told me to contact Shipa Delivery myself. As a customer, I should not be responsible for coordinating with the delivery partner when the mistake was not mine.

Today is already July 7, and my return package still has not been picked up despite my daily follow-ups. Every day I am told to wait until “tomorrow,” but no one comes to collect the package.

The Trendyol Assistant is also not helpful. It only provides automated responses, and it is very difficult to reach a live customer service representative. Even when I finally speak to an agent, they simply redirect me to Shipa instead of taking ownership of the issue and helping resolve it.

I just want my return to be collected as soon as possible so that my refund can be processed. My money has been tied up because of a mistake that was not my fault, and this delay is completely unacceptable.

This experience has been frustrating and stressful. I expected Trendyol to provide better customer support and take responsibility for issues like incorrect deliveries. I hope Trendyol improves its customer service and works more effectively with its delivery partners to prevent other customers from going through the same experience.

reviews.title: 50% Off? More Like 1 Dirham Off. Absolute Scam.
reviews.text:
If you’re thinking about downloading this app, think again. Trendyol hooks you with flashy “new user 50% off” banners, only to betray you the second you enter your card and address. The discount magically evaporates, shipping mysteriously inflates, and regional pricing somehow makes your basket cost more than the original price.

The interface pretends to be smooth and trendy, but it’s a wolf in designer sheep’s clothing. Coupons are capped, misleading, or outright useless, and customer support seems allergic to solving any actual problems. Trying to use this app feels like a game rigged against the player, where the only winning move is… not playing at all.

Honestly, I’d rather buy clothes from a street market blindfolded than deal with the bullcrap hidden in this app. Save your money, sanity, and data plan. This app deserves a hard uninstall and a permanent ban from your phone.

reviews.title: Customer service , and return policy
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. I returned my shipment according to the company’s instructions, but the return went missing. When I contacted customer support, they told me they “did not receive the return,” refused to communicate with the return shipping company, and said they cannot coordinate with other departments. As a result, they informed me that no refund will be issued.

I fulfilled my responsibility by returning the item, yet I am being held accountable for an internal or logistics failure. The lack of investigation, escalation, and accountability is unacceptable. I do not recommend this service due to poor customer support and unfair handling of return and refund issues.

reviews.title: Extremely unprofessional and irresponsible
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Trendyol’s return process. We requested a return on time, and the courier company they assigned (Shipa) never came to pick up the packages. We followed up every single day, but no one took responsibility. After 14 days of continuous follow-ups, Trendyol informed us—very irresponsibly—that the return window had expired and the return was no longer possible.

This is extremely unfair, as the delay was completely out of our control and caused by the courier they chose. Trendyol showed a clear lack of accountability and customer support. I expected much more responsibility and professionalism. Unfortunately, this experience has seriously damaged my trust in their service.

reviews.title: The worst App ever
reviews.text:
This was my first and last experience with the app, and it was the worst ever.
My order arrived in multiple separate deliveries without any prior notice. I wouldn’t have minded receiving it late in one complete delivery, instead of receiving it in scattered parts.

I also have missing items, and one product doesn’t match the picture.
Another item was unavailable, yet days after completing the order, it was canceled and I was told it was canceled “based on my request”—which never happened. Why wasn’t I informed earlier? And the compensation was 13 coupons… honestly ridiculous. 😂😂😂😂😂😂

Until now, the refund for the unavailable item hasn’t been processed.
Overall, a very bad experience—wouldn’t repeat it even if it were free.

I hope you can contact me so I can provide proof of the missing items and the product that doesn’t match the picture.

reviews.title: TWO MONTHS LATE Unshipped order!
reviews.text:
Dear Trendyol Customer Service,

I am writing to express my deep frustration regarding my order placed on September 24, which has still not been shipped or delivered as of today. Despite my multiple attempts to contact your customer service, submit complaints, and request updates, I have received no proper response, no explanation, and no resolution.

It is completely unacceptable that nearly TWO months have passed without any progress or communication. Moreover, there is NO direct contact number or email for escalation, and the seller has refused to cancel the shipment or refund my money even though the order has not yet been dispatched.

I demand an immediate solution, not more empty promises or automated replies. I expect either:
1. The immediate cancellation of my order and a full refund or 
2. The immediate shipment of my items with proof of dispatch.
